theme: An open day in St. Pete.
greeting: The calendar's clear today, Dan — nothing scheduled to bookend it. The girls are with you, and a short stack of Croatia-trip bookings are about the only things pulling at the day.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 19 Cavtat hotel night
needsAttention.detail: The last open night of the Dubrovnik trip — a room in Cavtat near the airport for Sat Sept 19, after the charter disembarks and before the 7:30am Sunday flight out. In Todoist on the Mike + Dan board, p1, two days overdue.

needsAttention.title: Cover the St Pete landing gap, Sept 20–22
needsAttention.detail: Two nights near St Pete between the TPA landing and the Tuesday 3pm kid pickup. Worth also glancing whether the Orlando-window Airbnb flipped from pending to confirmed. In Todoist, due today.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags on the Croatia ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags on the Eurowings Discover legs — cheap to fix online now, costly at the counter. Confirm the allowance on the operating carrier's own site. In Todoist, due today.

flagged.title: An SVP Global Public Policy 'interview update'
flagged.detail: A recruiter mail asks you to confirm work authorization through a link before naming the employer — verify the sender is real before acting on it.

flagged.title: Google flagged new Gmail access
flagged.detail: Two alerts confirm Claude for Gmail was granted access to your account — expected if that was you, worth a glance to be sure.

inbox.noise: About a dozen newsletters and promos — Responsible Investor, Monocle, NYT Cooking, plus a few sailing and baking lists.

recipe.title: Salmon Baked in Foil
recipe.why: High summer wants light hands: fish steamed gently in its own parcel, alongside whatever's ripe from the garden.

acts.line: The calendar's empty — a rare open morning to spend on something that's been waiting.
Nothing scheduled through the afternoon; the shape of the day is yours to set.
A quiet evening at home in Kenwood with the girls around.
